question: Half the Night is Gone' is written by which Sahitya Akademi winner?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amitabha Bagchi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Half the Night is Gone** is a critically acclaimed novel authored by **Amitabha Bagchi**.
 
• The book won the **Sahitya Akademi Award in 2019** in the English category, recognizing its literary excellence.
 
• It is a poignant exploration of themes such as **family, loss, and the impact of history on personal lives**, drawing inspiration from Indian traditions and societal structures.
 
• The narrative is structured through a blend of a fictionalized autobiography and a novel within the novel, showcasing Bagchi's unique storytelling style.
 
• Amitabha Bagchi is an acclaimed Indian author known for his works like **The Householder** and **Above Average**, which also delve into contemporary Indian life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amitav Ghosh**

 
 
• Amitav Ghosh is a renowned Indian author known for his works blending historical and contemporary themes.
 
• His notable books include **The Shadow Lines**, **The Glass Palace**, and the **Ibis Trilogy** (Sea of Poppies, River of Smoke, Flood of Fire).
 
• He was awarded the Jnanpith Award in 2018, one of India's highest literary honors.
 
 
 
• **Amit Chaudhuri**
 
 
• Amit Chaudhuri is a prominent Indian English author, poet, and essayist.
 
• His notable works include **A Strange and Sublime Address**, **Afternoon Raag**, and **The Immortals**.
 
• He has received numerous awards, including the Sahitya Akademi Award and the Commonwealth Writers' Prize.
 
 
 
• **Anuradha Roy**
 
 
• Anuradha Roy is an acclaimed Indian author whose novels often explore themes of love, loss, and societal change.
 
• Her notable works include **Sleeping on Jupiter**, which won the DSC Prize for South Asian Literature, and **All the Lives We Never Lived**.
 
• Her writing has been longlisted for the Booker Prize and translated into several languages.
 
 
 
• **About 'Half the Night is Gone'**
 
 
• The novel is set in post-colonial India and follows the intertwined lives of characters from different generations and backgrounds.
 
• It is deeply influenced by Indian epics like the Ramayana and Mahabharata, weaving traditional storytelling methods into modern narratives.
 
• The book delves into the complexities of human relationships, societal norms, and the legacy of colonialism in India.
